text: 10 OVERDOSAGE After oral administration of lovastatin immediate-release to mice the median lethal dose observed was >15 g/m 2 . Five healthy human volunteers have received up to 200 mg of lovastatin as a single dose without clinically significant adverse experiences. A few cases of accidental overdosage with lovastatin immediate-release have been reported; no patients had any specific symptoms, and all patients recovered without sequelae. The maximum dose taken was 5 g to 6 g. Until further experience is obtained, no specific treatment of overdosage with Altoprev ® can be recommended. The dialyzability of lovastatin and its metabolites in man is not known at present.
